items.title: 2026 Self-Host User Survey Results
items.summary: Visualized results across 6,200+ responses to 2026's annual user survey
items.body:
Thanks to all who participated in the 2026 Self-Host User Survey! In total, it received 6,221 completed responses – a 52% increase from last year!

This year’s results (visualized below with Chart.js) include an optional prior year overlay, a new section on AI use, and a question about Linux distributions – one of the most requested additions from past feedback.

If you're looking for more content throughout the year, subscribe to my weekly newsletter for the latest in self-hosting news and activity.

🚀

This year's survey was sponsored by and self-hosted using the open source survey software Formbricks.
